proposedNewPolicy.boundedAuthority: One source-bound scalar successor policy; no new generation, RGB edit, unrelated terrain engine or tool-family expansion.
proposedNewPolicy.necessaryNewMath: Evaluate only an explicit reviewed2D triangle mesh with shared artist-authored scalar vertex heights using barycentric weights. New semantic component is bounded and source-specific; no automatic terrain inference.
proposedNewPolicy.coarseField: Each triangle interpolates its3 reviewed vertex rises. Inside weights are nonnegative and sum1, so rise remains within authored vertex extrema. Shared vertices give identical height along shared edges (C0). H_semantic=H_snow+gblur(source_authored_rise,sigma_contact), with no final hard class selector.
proposedNewPolicy.continuity: The raw source-control mesh is C0; unchanged wrapped Gaussian only smooths contact/normal kinks. There is no separated lower/facing floor and no hard class-selected height jump.
proposedNewPolicy.embedding: Interior pilot contact vertices are proposed to meet snow at relative rise0, with visible crest/face controls roughly .16-.24. This is a source-specific embedded-contact hypothesis. Proposed post-field smoothing2master pixels, not an old pre-selector bevel. Whole-source clipped bodies require explicit wrap/contact continuation controls; no image perimeter fade.
proposedNewPolicy.facetShape: A small constrained/shared-vertex mesh must follow the actual source face zones/creases; no arbitrary triangulation ridges. The actual12 source controls and complete4-zone neutral partition are provided, but mesh edges/triangle connectivity remain a planning gate.
proposedNewPolicy.macroAmplitude: Proposed snow baseline .55, positive crest controls .16-.24 (upper~.79 before fine detail), same .3/.5 normals, same lights and photographic gain. Report actual pilot witness rises against failed~.18-.21; no automatic rescale/flattening to improve appearance.
proposedNewPolicy.microDetail: Recompute existing craft float64 and prove its float32 replay equals initial NPY. Keep gain .1 (same as failed .05micro policy). Preserve existing snow detail B-.5; use fine-only rock residual B-gblur(B,8master pixels). Blend these with a softly wrapped reviewed MATERIAL-role weight, not elevation membership, so pale caps/veins do not choose the lower plane. No per-pore amplitude fit or normalization.
proposedNewPolicy.microLimit: Removing broad rock tonal contrast is intentional separation from shading/staining, but may omit real broad rock roughness. Semantic facet controls must supply visible broad faces; actual RMS/PSD and source crop comparison must show useful photographic fine detail without new noise.
proposedNewPolicy.noClipping: Convex interpolation prevents affine extrapolation beyond authored extrema. Finite/no-clipping0..1 remains required after filtered field and micro; reject, never clip. One finalfloat32 cast.
proposedNewPolicy.RGBContract: Canonical RGB PNG bytes must equal verified initial color.png. Raw/native/prompt/generationCount remain unchanged.
